author: terencechain
content: just catching up, I'd prefer simplicity, `min_bid` and `boost_factor` stay global only for p2p, per-builder overrides only exist for direct url builders. I agree wire and config formats should be fork scoped, not sure the keymanager api needs to be fork versioned though. fwiw in prysm we only cache the highest bid per (slot, parent_hash, parent_root) anyway, so per-builder p2p settings would be a no-op or nondeterministic for us as well

author: nflaig
content:
> not sure the keymanager api needs to be fork versioned though
I don't want consumers to have to provide the `Eth-Consensus-Version` header there, maybe normal versioning (v1, v2, etc.) works there pretty well, we can also see how we wanna define a interchange format, that would have a `version` in it too, the slashing protection interchange format is a good example for this that worked well in the past
